info.title: Unwritten — git-history-based hole detector.
info.description: Git-history-based hole detector: flags files that are expected to change together with your edit but are absent. MCP server + pre-commit CLI.

options.name: --staged
options.description: Check the currently staged files.

options.name: --base
options.description:
Measure changes against this revision instead of
HEAD (use after committing work in progress).

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository root (default: current directory).

options.name: --min-confidence
options.description: Report floor, Wilson lower bound (default 0.6).

options.name: --fail-at
options.description: Exit 1 if any hole reaches this confidence (default 0.7).

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat content-suppressed holes as real holes.

commands.name: install-hook
commands.description: Install hooks that run the check

options.name: --staged
options.description: Check the currently staged files.

options.name: --base
options.description:
Measure changes against this revision instead of
HEAD (use after committing work in progress).

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository root (default: current directory).

options.name: --min-confidence
options.description: Report floor, Wilson lower bound (default 0.6).

options.name: --fail-at
options.description: Exit 1 if any hole reaches this confidence (default 0.7).

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Treat content-suppressed holes as real holes.
Defaults can be overridden per repo in .unwritten/config.json.

options.name: --force.
options.description:
unwritten ignore <trigger> <hole> Mute a false rule until the trigger has
changed N more times (--for <n>,
default 30). --list / --remove manage
existing ignores.
unwritten --version               Print the tool version.
